page_title: AI visibility and content creation with Eden | PromptEden

sources.entry: PromptEden - AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) monitoring. Tracks how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Grok describe your brand and which competitors they recommend instead, across 9+ AI platforms refreshed daily.

summary.name: PromptEden
summary.one_liner: PromptEden is a paid AI visibility (AEO) monitoring tool that tracks how AI engines describe your brand, which competitors they recommend, and which sources they cite, with an assistant called Eden that explains the evidence and helps draft content.
use_cases: Monitor how ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini describe your brand
Compare your brand's AI share of voice against competitors
Inspect sources cited in AI answers
Track AI referral traffic alongside Google traffic
Draft articles for a team with the Eden assistant
Generate a free shareable AI visibility scorecard
summary.what_it_does: PromptEden monitors a set of user-defined prompts across AI answer engines and records the captured answers that mention the user's brand. It shows a visibility score, AI share of voice, and rank against competitors over time, and lets users inspect cited sources and competitor mentions. Eden, its built-in assistant, is used to explain the captured evidence and help create content for a project. The page lists monitoring of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, and the listing also cites Copilot, Perplexity and Grok across 9+ platforms refreshed daily. A free AI visibility report gives a shareable scorecard without an account.
notable: Tracks brand and competitor mentions across AI engines with cited-source inspection
Eden assistant explains monitoring evidence and drafts content
Free shareable AI visibility scorecard without account or card
Business tier refreshes monitoring every 3 hours; Starter and Pro daily
caveats: Paid monthly plans: Starter $49, Pro $129, Business $349 per month
Money-back guarantee applies to the first paid charge within 30 days; cancel anytime
API access only on Pro and Business tiers
